cascade_requests.text: Our invoices since March show double-charged VAT for EU customers on annual plans only. Work out the likely root cause from the attached line-item patterns and propose a remediation plan.

offline_mock.reason: multi-step diagnosis across billing rules plus a plan
offline_mock.answer: Likely root cause: the March tax-engine upgrade applies VAT at invoice generation AND again in the annual-plan proration step. Plan: (1) hotfix proration to skip tax lines, (2) identify affected invoices via line_type=proration_tax, (3) issue credit notes, (4) add a regression test on annual EU plans.

cascade_requests.text: Draft a zero-downtime migration plan for moving 40 custom webhook integrations to the v3 API, including rollback steps.

offline_mock.reason: long-horizon plan with dependencies and rollback
offline_mock.answer: Plan: (1) inventory the 40 webhooks and group by event type, (2) dual-write v2+v3 behind a flag, (3) migrate in 4 waves of 10 with canary checks, (4) cut over reads per wave, (5) rollback = flip the flag back to v2 (dual-write keeps v2 warm), (6) decommission v2 after 14 days clean.
